Trainee Software Engineer at CodeStore. Noida, Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. Apply for this Trainee Software Engineer opportunity through the original employer or job source.

Job Description

We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated Trainee Software Engineers who are passionate about software development and eager to build a career in technology. As a trainee, you will work alongside experienced developers, learn industry best practices, and contribute to real-world projects while receiving structured mentoring and training. Key Responsibilities Participate in software development projects under the guidance of senior developers. Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code. Learn and work with technologies such as .NET, Angular, React, Node.js, Java, SQL, Azure, or other relevant technologies. Debug, test, and troubleshoot software applications. Assist in developing web applications, APIs, and databases. Participate in code reviews and team discussions. Follow Agile/Scrum development methodologies. Document technical specifications and development activities. Stay updated with emerging technologies and continuously improve technical skills. Adhere to coding standards, security practices, and company policies. Requirements Technical Skills Good understanding of programming fundamentals and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP). Knowledge of at least one programming language (C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, or C++). Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Familiarity with SQL and relational databases. Understanding of APIs and web technologies. Basic knowledge of Git or any version control system. Knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC). Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Good communication skills. Willingness to learn and adapt quickly. Team player with a positive attitude. Strong attention to detail. Good time management and organizational skills. Educational Qualification Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field. Recent graduates or final-year students awaiting results may also apply. Preferred Qualifications Internship or academic project experience. Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure. Understanding of REST APIs. Basic exposure to AI tools such as GitHub Copilot or ChatGPT. Portfolio or GitHub profile showcasing personal projects. Benefits Competitive salary with performance reviews. Structured training and mentorship program. Work on live client projects. Exposure to modern technologies (.NET, Angular, Azure, AI, Cloud). Clear career progression to Software Engineer. Certification and learning reimbursement. Flexible and collaborative work environment. Paid leave and company holidays. Employee recognition and reward programs. Team outings and engagement activities. Opportunity to work with international clients.
